calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.category = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
  AND r.store_key NOT IN (
    SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id = 999
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS return_count
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'

SELECT DISTINCT category
FROM dim_product
WHERE category LIKE '%Garden%' OR category LIKE '%Furniture%'
ORDER BY category

SELECT DISTINCT category, subcategory
FROM dim_product
WHERE category = 'Garden'
ORDER BY category, subcategory
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS return_count,
  COALESCE(s.store_id, 999) AS store_id,
  p.category
FROM fact_return_line r
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
  AND p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY COALESCE(s.store_id, 999), p.category
